title: Apple Roses
description: Beautiful pastry roses made from puff pastry strips, apricot jam and thin-sliced red apples. Impressive as a dessert but surprisingly simple to make.
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C/180°C fan. Grease 6 holes of a muffin tray with plenty of butter.
Defrost the pastry and roll into a neat rectangle. Slice into 6 long strips.
Core the apples, halve, and cut into super-thin segments (no more than 2mm thick).
Spread a tablespoon of apricot jam along the first strip. Lay apple segments lengthways along the top edge, slightly overlapping, with the curved side overhanging.
Starting at one end, gently roll the pastry into a cylinder gathering the apple. Secure with the end of the pastry and place apple-end up in a muffin case. Repeat for all 6.
Bake for about 45 minutes until pastry is puffed and golden and apples just starting to singe.
notes: Makes 6 roses. Remove from tray immediately after baking — they can stick if left to cool inside.
